title: Debug endpoint exposes a synthetic configuration value
evidence: Synthetic HTTP transcript: GET /debug returns DEMO_TOKEN=not-a-secret.
remediation: Remove debug routes from deployed builds; check logs and rotate credentials if real exposure is verified.

title: Missing session cookie security attributes
evidence: Synthetic Set-Cookie header lacks Secure and HttpOnly.
remediation: Set Secure and HttpOnly; select a suitable SameSite policy and test login flows.

title: Server response discloses an application build label
remediation: Remove unnecessary build details from public response headers; retest responses.
